verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation describes idle databases scaling to zero or a no-cost tier for prototypes. The only supporting mention is a 2021 beta-era community comment that costs 'scale to 0' (planetscale-comm-9). A later community comment says the hobby tier has been removed (planetscale-comm-5), so the old comment does not establish current scale-to-zero behavior. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
